description: Returns official IRS contribution limits for 2025, 2026 and 2027: 401(k)/403(b)/TSP and 457(b) elective deferral ($24,500 for 2026), age 50+ catch-up ($8,000 for 2026), the SECURE 2.0 age 60-63 super catch-up ($11,250), IRA limit and catch-up ($7,500 + $1,100 for 2026), SIMPLE limits, 415(c) total ($72,000), 401(a)(17) compensation limit, highly compensated employee threshold, Roth IRA phase-outs, HSA self/family limits (2027: $4,500 / $9,000, Rev. Proc. 2026-24) and the Social Security wage base (2027: $192,300). Also states the Roth catch-up rule status. Figures copied from IRS Notices 2024-80 and 2025-67 and the HSA Rev. Procs. 2027 plan and IRA limits were not yet announced on 2026-11-02 and the tool says so instead of guessing.
